states: An authenticated proxy viewer received requiresAuth=true and systemSettingsRead=false; the normal application shell rendered and no /api/updates/status request was emitted during an 11.5 second observation window.

An authenticated proxy administrator received requiresAuth=true and systemSettingsRead=true; the normal application shell rendered and three /api/updates/status requests were emitted during an 11.5 second observation window.
An auth-free backend returned requiresAuth=false without settings capabilities and continued to serve /api/updates/status with HTTP 200.
The administrator shell rendered at 1280x800 and 375x812 with document scroll width equal to the viewport width.
interactions: Built and launched an isolated backend with proxy authentication plus separate header-injecting viewer and administrator proxies.
Loaded the authenticated viewer shell, observed two polling intervals, and confirmed the proxy logged no update-status requests while the direct route correctly returned HTTP 403.
Loaded the authenticated administrator shell, observed two polling intervals, and confirmed the proxy logged three update-status requests while the direct route returned HTTP 200.
Restarted the isolated backend without authentication and confirmed both the public security status and the still-open update-status route returned HTTP 200.
Inspected the administrator shell at desktop and narrow viewports and confirmed there was no horizontal document overflow.
